claim: In the multilingual translation strategy, extract first and translate second: read/extract source material in the original language when possible before relying on translation.
sub_question: What is the rule about extraction versus translation order?
evidence: Translation Strategy section states extract-first order; workflow steps 4-5 also sequence extract in original language before translating key findings.
quote_or_anchor: Extract first, translate second: Always read source material in original language when possible before relying on translation
notes: Also supported by workflow steps 4 (Extract in original language) and 5 (Translate key findings).
